messages:
customer_julia: Hi, hitting a 400 when calling a tool via the API. Works in some clients but fails when I paste from Windows Notepad — likely smartquotes / percent signs getting mangled. Error: "Tool validation failed: invalid JSON in 'tool_args' (Unexpected token)". Repro attached below.

support_maya: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact payload you sent (raw) and the curl command? Also which SDK/version?

customer_julia: Using curl from Windows PowerShell. SDK not involved. Here's the curl I used and the body I pasted (copied from a doc that had smart quotes):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/tool_call \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d "{\"tool\": \"pdf-extract\", \"tool_args\": \"{\"path\": \"C:\\Users\\Julia\\Docs\\report.docx\", \"range\": \"1-3\",}\" }"
```

customer_julia: The key bit is that the inner JSON string has a trailing comma and the quotes in the source looked like “smart” quotes when I copied from Word.

runtime_bot: ERROR  txn=0a7f3c4b id=err-9f3d TOOL_VALIDATION_ERROR message="invalid JSON in tool_args"

support_maya: Got it. Two likely issues: (1) trailing comma inside the JSON string (`... \"range\": \"1-3\",}`) which makes strict parsers fail, and (2) smart quotes / non-ASCII quote chars get pasted as U+201C / U+201D and break JSON. Can you try replacing the inner string with a properly escaped JSON without trailing comma and with straight quotes?

customer_julia: Tried that and it works. But we need this to not silently explode for our users who paste docs. Any chance the API could return a clearer error pointing out smart quotes vs normal quotes? Right now it's just a generic invalid JSON.

eng_ryan: Thanks for the report — this looks like a gap in the server-side validation sanitization. The runtime expects `tool_args` to be valid JSON or a raw string containing valid JSON. If clients paste smart quotes, the quick fail is expected. We should surface a friendlier error and possibly attempt a safe normalization (convert U+201C/U+201D/U+2018/U+2019 to ASCII quotes) before final parse.

se_alex: Repro steps for eng: 1) On Windows, copy this text from Word and paste into PowerShell as the `-d` body. 2) Run the curl above. 3) Observe response 400 and runtime_bot error id. I've attached the minimal failing body below (exact bytes shown):

```json
{"tool":"pdf-extract","tool_args":"{\"path\": \"C:\\Users\\Julia\\Docs\\report.docx\", \"range\": \"1-3\",}"}
```

se_alex: Note the U+0001 markers where smart quotes got mapped by the paste shim — this is why some clients show weird control chars.

eng_ryan: Good catch on the paste shim mapping. Action items: 1) small server patch to detect non-ASCII quotes/control chars in `tool_args` and return an error code `TOOLARGS_UNSAFE_CHARS` with a hint to normalize quotes; 2) long-term: try a best-effort normalization on the parsing layer but only as an opt-in config because auto-mangling text could hide real bugs.

support_maya: For the customer — short-term workaround: wrap inner JSON with `json.dumps` equivalent (i.e., ensure inner JSON is double-escaped in the body) or replace smart quotes with straight ones before sending. Example that worked for Julia: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/tool_call \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tool":"pdf-extract","tool_args":"{\"path\": \"C:\\Users\\Julia\\Docs\\report.docx\", \"range\": \"1-3\"}"}'
```

customer_julia: That worked, thanks. Can you escalate to runtime so we get the clearer error? It's been a frequent support touchpoint for us. :pray:

support_maya: Already created an internal ticket and linked the runtime error id err-9f3d. I'll ping when the patch lands.

eng_ryan: Filed ENG-1129 to add the `TOOLARGS_UNSAFE_CHARS` validation and an optional normalization flag for Private customers. Assigning to eng-runtime; adding se_alex for context.

customer_julia: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Leaving this thread open until the server-side hint is live.

support_maya: Will follow up here when there is a deploy. In the meantime, if any other folks hitting similar issues, please ask them to paste the raw bytes (use `xxd -g 1` or `hexdump -C`) so we can triage encoding problems quickly. :mag:
notes: Contains a customer repro, patch request, and action items for eng-runtime. Emphasizes Windows paste/smartquote + trailing comma causing invalid JSON in tool_args.
